name: scene_rs
provenance: RealSense D435i across the room, depth 640x480@15 + colour 640x480@15, USB 2.1, negotiated against what the device reports it has. Depth is aligned to colour by librealsense and averaged over 12 frames, valid pixels only.
notes: rotated 180 deg: the camera is mounted upside down and the principal point is rotated WITH the image (cx'=W-1-cx)
liveness: 12 frames, 7 distinct depth images, 7 distinct frame numbers, 15% of pixels valid
